Прогноз: 1X (Leeds не проигрывает)

In-form Leeds will hope to continue their bright start to the new Premier League campaign as they host Crystal Palace , whose hectic schedule is now in full swing.

Match News and Current Form

Leeds thrashed Newcastle 4-1 at Elland Road on Monday night to make this their best start to a Premier League campaign since 2001/02 (W2, D2), with that promisingly a season which ended with qualification for the UEFA Cup. The only blot on the Whites’ copybook in six games across all competitions so far this term came in the shape of an EFL Cup exit at Chelsea (W3, D2), and another victory on home soil here would see them equal their best-ever start to a Premier League season. The success being enjoyed by Daniel Farke’s side this season hasn’t come as too much of a surprise given they performed quite well in the second half of last season, meaning they have now lost just five of their last 29 Premier League matches (W10, D14) - the fifth most points in the division in that time.

Palace have won three of their last four games across all competitions (L1), and kickstarted their UEFA Europa League (UEL) campaign with a comfortable 4-0 home win over Lech Poznań on Thursday night, but have picked up just three Premier League points so far this term (W1, L3). Subsequently lingering close to the relegation zone ahead of matchday five, summer appointment Pierre Sage saw his side lose 3-2 at home to newly-promoted Ipswich last weekend after going down to ten men, and ominously, Palace have now conceded 2+ goals in each of their last ten Premier League games, in what is the competition’s second-longest such streak ever!

Head-to-Head History

Palace have lost just one of the pair’s last five competitive meetings (W2, D2), but Leeds have won four of their last six Premier League home H2Hs against the Eagles (L2).

Hot Stats and Streaks

Leeds have registered 5+ shots on target in four of their last five competitive games.

Leeds have scored three set-piece goals in their four league games this term.

Six of Palace’s last eight league games saw both teams score.

Palace have taken a league-low nine corners across the first four rounds of the season.

Key Players to Watch and Missing Players

Leeds’ Noah Okafor has registered eight goal involvements in his last 11 Premier League appearances (G7, A1), scoring his first of the season last time out. Having gone ten Palace appearances without a goal involvement prior, Jørgen Strand Larsen has now recorded five in their last three games (G4, A1).

Leeds remain without Joe Rodon . Palace see Axel Disasi serve a red card suspension, with their absentees also including Dean Henderson and Jean-Philippe Mateta .

For all the latest team news, please check the Flashscore match centre.

Betting Analysis

The hosts are flying and the Elland Road atmosphere plays a huge factor, so Leeds to win and both teams to score appears a suitable combination here.

Author: Ben Olawumi
